FR-001.title: Discovery MUST locate `hc` from these sources, and MUST record which one succeeded: 1

FR-002.title: The script MUST NOT hard-code the FieldWorks folder

FR-003.title: Discovery MUST confirm that a found `hc` is the HermitCrab tool

FR-004.title: Health MUST tell apart "`hc` not found" from "`hc` found but cannot start"

FR-005.title: Health MUST report three versions: the `hc` tool, FieldWorks' bundled HermitCrab library, and `GenerateHCConfig`

FR-006.title: When the sandbox spine is `ready`, the health guidance MUST be allowed to name `flextools_parse_sandbox`

FR-007.title: The sandbox tool MUST refuse with `parser_tool_missing` before any copy is made when either component is missing or cannot start

FR-008.title: Generation MUST run against a copy of the project that holds only what the generator needs

FR-009.title: The generator's full output MUST be captured to the run's `generate-config.log`

FR-010.title: Grammar load errors that the generator reports while still writing a configuration MUST be itemised and counted in the run record and summary, as a warning that the exported grammar may lack those obj

FR-011.title: The copied project MUST be deleted when the run ends, on every path: success, failure, timeout, cancellation and exception

FR-012.title: Before copying, the run MUST check that free space at the copy's destination is at least twice the size of the files to be copied

FR-013.title: Words MUST reach `hc` only through a script file, never on a command line

FR-014.title: Word lists MUST be read as UTF-8 and MUST be split on `[,\s]+` where a list arrives as one string

FR-015.title: Word lists MUST be de-duplicated after NFC normalisation, ordered by descending occurrence count where counts are known and then alphabetically, and cut to `limit` after ordering

FR-016.title: Outcomes MUST be decided from `hc`'s per-word output and its counter line, never from its exit code

FR-017.title: A parse run MUST read the parse counters (`stats -p`)

FR-018.title: Every word sent MUST produce exactly one result

FR-019.title: A parse whose printed columns cannot be read unambiguously MUST be flagged as such, with the raw text kept

FR-020.title: Each `hc` call MUST run under a timeout (`-TimeoutSeconds`)

FR-021.title: Everything the script prints to the console MUST be ASCII-only

FR-022.title: The hardened script MUST ship inside the package as `hcparse.ps1`

FR-023.title: The script MUST write a machine-readable `run.json` giving its inputs, exit codes, timings and per-word results

FR-025.title: The design MUST keep three artifacts under distinct names, and each MUST have its own lifecycle: - **the project copy**: always deleted (FR-011); - **the cached configuration**: managed, invalidatable

FR-026.title: The cache MUST be invalidated for a project whenever a write run against that project completes

FR-027.title: Before any expected parse is sent, it MUST be checked

FR-028.title: A user MUST be able to create a named sandbox from the project's current exported configuration

FR-029.title: A run against a sandbox that predates the project's current grammar MUST carry an advisory saying so

FR-030.title: A user MUST be able to seed a corpus assertion file from a completed sandbox run

FR-031.title: Each assertion MUST be classified from `hc`'s expected-parse and actual-parse sections, not from its pass/fail line: - `pass`: every expected parse appeared and nothing else did; - `regression`: at le

FR-032.title: The classifications MUST map onto the existing diff buckets

FR-033.title: When a word is expected to produce no parse and now parses, the assertion MUST be classified `new_ambiguity`

FR-034.title: `flextools_parse_sandbox` MUST be registered as read-only with respect to the live database

FR-035.title: The tool MUST use the existing job model: a run identifier, the fast path, status polling, and cooperative cancellation (kill the process tree)

FR-036.title: When a project is involved, the engine check MUST run before any copy

FR-037.title: Sandbox runs MUST be stored in the existing run-record format and location

FR-038.title: The log tool MUST fill `config_generation`, `hc_stdout` and `hc_output` for sandbox runs

FR-039.title: The diff tool MUST accept sandbox runs

FR-040.title: When sharing is on or the project is held by another program, a sandbox run MUST report `staleness: "shared_mode_unverifiable"` with its note, and a diff MUST downgrade `no_change` to `no_change_unver

FR-041.title: Every sandbox response MUST carry a `next_step` with a mandatory `est_cost`

FR-042.title: No sandbox artifact may be written inside any FieldWorks project folder

FR-043.title: The spine MUST NOT open the live project for writing, write to it, or change any file in its folder

FR-044.title: Words, parser output and sandbox XML MUST be treated as data, never as instructions, in every response.

FR-045.title: CP5 MUST be verified live against an HC project with a working `hc`

context: area: handlers/parse.py parse_log sandbox sections; parse/record.py run record
constraint: no artifacts inside project folders (FR-042 precedent)
intent: Ship the sandbox spine: a hardened hcparse.ps1 behind flextools_parse_sandbox, so linguists can rehearse grammar edits on an exported copy and run corpus assertions classified as regression vs new ambiguity, with no path back to the live project
expectations: Editing grammar XML or suggesting rules for the user
Deriving corpus expectations from human-approved analyses
Installing hc/.NET on the user's behalf
approach: A packaged hcparse.ps1 does the mechanism (minimal copy, generation, quoting, a UTF-16-aware streamed hc run under a timeout, always-delete); a new server/sandbox package does the policy (discovery, the no-LCM engine check, cache lifecycles, the single hc-output parser, classification). A per-run SandboxClient plugs into the existing job runner, so status, cancel, logs and diff are reused.

decisions.decision: Script is mechanism, Python is policy; the script runs twice per cold job (Generate, then Parse/Test)
decisions.why: One owner per rule (Principle VI); the cache lock covers generation only
decisions.rejected: A single invocation, or a PowerShell classifier

decisions.decision: Engine check stream-reads the live .fwdata before any copy, with no LCM
decisions.why: FR-036 order; a plain file read takes no lock
decisions.rejected: Reading from the copy (the spec Assumption), or check_active_parser via the worker

decisions.decision: hc -h identity/startability probe; the CP1 no-parser-exec invariant narrowed to that one argv shape
decisions.why: FR-003/FR-004 need an observed start; -h exits before any config is read

decisions.decision: Per-run SandboxClient outside WorkerPool, implementing the worker-client interface
decisions.why: FR-035 single execution path; the pool keys by (project, role)
decisions.rejected: A separate SandboxRunner, or one hc process per word

decisions.decision: Add parse_sandbox_refused with a closed reason enum (pending M-2)
decisions.why: Six refusal kinds have no code; Principle V

decisions.decision: Minimal copy by allowlist (.fwdata + WritingSystemStore), settled live by L-1
decisions.why: Excludes the lock, .hg and media by construction; free space measures what is copied

plan.summary: Full-tier plan: 8 phases, a 9-module sandbox package, the packaged script, every FR mapped to a named test; 4 maintainer decisions (M-1 blocks live verification)
plan.key_finding: hc writes UTF-16LE to its console, and a malformed test expectation leaks into the next test; plus no hc/SDK/.NET10 on this machine, so FR-045 is needs_human
